subject: Aurora: observability add-on concession request (retention, tracing, dashboards)
messages:
From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@aurorahealth.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: Ben O'Connor <boconnor@aurorahealth.com>, procurement@aurorahealth.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jul 2028 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Request: add-on pricing — retention + tracing + dashboards

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo last week — the platform looks good and we've run an internal cost model. We are close to a commit (targeting $120k/mo base committed usage) but the blocker for our CFO and procurement is the add-on economics on observability: retention surcharge, tracing (per-ingest), and the advanced dashboards fees.

Two asks from our side:
- Can Redwood waive the retention surcharge for the first 6 months while we onboard and tune sampling?
- Can you provide at least a 25% discount on tracing unit pricing for year 1 if we lock a 12-month commitment at $120k/mo?
- For advanced dashboards, we'd like a pilot inclusion (basic dashboards + 500k query credits) to evaluate value before accepting full license fees.

If you can provide a written concession path (SOW or attachment) we can move procurement toward PO. I attached a quick CSV with our expected tracing ingestion profile (tracing-pricing-sheet.csv).

Can we get a proposal by EOD Wednesday? We’re aiming to finalize vendor selection this week.

Best,
Asha Patel
Head of Platform
Aurora Health

(Attachment: tracing-pricing-sheet.csv)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, Ben O'Connor <boconnor@aurorahealth.com>, procurement@aurorahealth.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jul 2028 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: add-on pricing — retention + tracing + dashboards

Hi Asha — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the ingestion profile. Really glad Aurora is close to committing.

Quick update: I’ve looped in Jordan (pricing) and Marcus (commercial/legal) to put together a concrete concession outline. We can do a short SOW addendum to capture any temporary waivers and pilot terms.

Next steps:
- Jordan: propose the pricing/concession terms (discounts, credits, length).
- Marcus: confirm wording we can commit to in SOW and flag any approval gates.
- Kimberly: I’ll coordinate to get a DocuSign-ready SOW once we have numbers.

I’ll aim to get a proposal back to you by EOD Wednesday — if that timing shifts I’ll update.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Cc: Asha Patel <asha.patel@aurorahealth.com>, Ben O'Connor <boconnor@aurorahealth.com>, procurement@aurorahealth.com
Date: Tue, 16 Jul 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed concession package for Aurora (retention/tracing/dashboards)

Team / Asha —

Based on the ingestion profile and Kimberly’s note, here’s a pragmatic concession we can offer that balances Aurora’s ask with our margin and precedent:

1) Retention surcharge: waive surcharge for the first 3 months. For months 4–6 we offer a 50% credit (applied as monthly invoice credit) on estimated surcharge. After month 6 regular surcharge applies unless we’ve tuned sampling to target the agreed baseline.

2) Tracing unit pricing: 25% off list for year 1 conditioned on a 12-month $120k/mo commit. Discount drops to 10% in year 2 if the commit continues.

3) Advanced dashboards: include a 90-day pilot bundle that covers basic advanced dashboards plus 500k query credits and one integration session. Post-pilot, Aurora can convert to the standard dashboards SKU with a one-time onboarding fee (we can discount onboarding 50% if they sign within 30 days).

4) One-time onboarding credit: instead of a deeper ongoing discount, offer a $25k onboarding credit to be applied to the first invoice to offset migration costs.

I have attached a draft SOW addendum (Aurora_SOW_v2.docx) with the above language and line-item impacts on ARR and first-year revenue. High level P&L impact: estimated revenue concession ~ $58k in year 1 vs baseline, roughly 2.3% of projected ARR for this deal; still within our regional allowance if we get AE+Sales Manager approval.

If Aurora is good with this structure we can quickly:
- Finalize SOW addendum and send for DocuSign (Kimberly to coordinate).
- Get procurement a single PO referencing deal AUR-2028-41.

Asha — ping me if you want any line-item rework (e.g., longer retention waiver in exchange for higher commit).

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Sr. Pricing Manager, Redwood Inference

(Attachment: Aurora_SOW_v2.docx)

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: Asha Patel <asha.patel@aurorahealth.com>, procurement@aurorahealth.com
Date: Tue, 16 Jul 2028 09:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed concession package for Aurora (retention/tracing/dashboards)

Kim / Jordan / Asha —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A few commercial/legal housekeeping items before we send anything official to procurement:

- Tighten the retention-credit triggers in the SOW: define the sampling/KB baselines that unlock the month-4 credits (we should include an objective metric and a short remediation plan).
- Convert the onboarding credit into explicit line item credit (so bookkeeping and GAAP treatment are clear).
- If we’re offering a 90-day dashboard pilot, add acceptance criteria and a roll-to-paid clause with a clear expiry (e.g., pilot auto-terminates after 90 days unless Aurora opts in with a signed addendum).

From an approvals perspective we can proceed with the proposed dollar impacts, but I’ll need Sales Manager sign-off. Jordan — please update the SOW with the metric language and the explicit GL codes for the onboarding credit. Kimberly — once updated I’ll route it to legal and ops for final sign-off; target turnaround 48 hours.

Asha — appreciate the flexibility. If procurement can draft a PO referencing AUR-2028-41 that will speed processing once legal clears the SOW.

Marcus Lin
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
